badge_template.description: To be able to scale the availability of GitLab Migration Services, GitLab Professional Services offers a certification process for engineers who want to deliver this service to customers. The program is currently available to GitLab team members as well as selected GitLab Certified Services Partners. The certification validates the skills and knowledge needed to successfully migrate a customer's data from their legacy systems to GitLab.
badge_template.name: GitLab Certified Migration Services Professional

badge_template_activities.title: To earn this certification, candidates must successfully complete the following migration-related tasks: Review migration services resources, including documentation and delivery kits, pass a graded migration assessment, complete a congregate-onboarding workshop, shadow a migration that is lead by a PSE Migration Engineer, and lead a migration with a PSE Migration Engineer observing and providing feedback.

badge_template.description: Individuals who earn the GitLab Professional Services Engineer certification are able to demonstrate hands-on proficiency implementing GitLab, and are able to articulate the most common GitLab customer use cases.
badge_template.name: GitLab Certified Services Engineer Professional

badge_template_activities.title: To earn this certification, candidates must earn GitLab Certified Git Certified Associate, GitLab Certified CI/CD Associate, GitLab Project Management Associate, GitLab Certified Security Specialist, GitLab Migration Services Specialist, and GitLab Implementation Services Specialist.

badge_template.description: Individuals who earn the GitLab Certified CI/CD Associate certification are able to define what CI/CD is, identify the key components needed for a CI/CD pipeline, explain GitLab’s CI/CD functions, and understand how to utilize GitLab's CI/CD functions.
badge_template.name: GitLab Certified CI/CD Associate

badge_template_activities.title: GitLab Certified CI/CD Associate is a technical certification offered by GitLab Professional Services to help the GitLab community and team members validate their ability to apply GitLab concurrent DevOps processes and best practices in their daily work. To earn certification, candidates must first pass a 1-hour written assessment, followed by a 1-hour hands-on lab assessment graded by GitLab Professional Services engineers.

badge_template.description: Individuals who earn GitLab Git Certified Associate certification are able to explain what GitLab is and why teams use it, perform basic Git commands for branching, merging, and remote work, and apply fundamental concepts and skills using GitLab within the DevOps lifecycle.
badge_template.name: GitLab Certified Git Associate

badge_template_activities.title: GitLab Certified Git Associate is a technical certification offered by GitLab Professional Services to help the GitLab community and team members validate their ability to apply GitLab in their daily DevOps work. To earn a certification, candidates must first pass a 1-hour written assessment, followed by a 2-hour hands-on lab assessment graded by GitLab Professional Services engineers.

badge_template.description: Individuals who earn GitLab Certified Implementation Engineer Professional certification are able to explain what GitLab install configurations are available and what components are used for implementations as well as, perform basic administrative actions in the GitLab system, and apply fundamental concepts and skills using GitLab.
badge_template.name: GitLab Certified Implementation Services Professional

badge_template_activities.title: To earn certification, candidates must pass both a written assessment and a hands-on lab assessment.

badge_template.description: Individuals who earn the GitLab Project Management Specialist certification are able to define the Agile PM process, set up projects by creating issues, labels, milestones, and groups; manage projects using GitLab boards, epics, and roadmaps, as well as use GitLab to develop their portfolio plans.
badge_template.name: GitLab Certified Project Management Associate

badge_template_activities.title: GitLab Certified Project Management Associate is a technical certification offered by GitLab Professional Services to help the GitLab community and team members validate their ability to use GitLab for lean and agile project management, from basic issue tracking to scrum and agile style project management throughout the complete DevOps lifecycle. To earn certification, candidates must first pass a written assessment, followed by a hands-on lab assessment graded by GitLab Professional Services.

badge_template.description: Individuals who earn GitLab Certified Security Specialist certification can showcase their ability to enable essential security capabilities of GitLab including SAST, DAST, dependency and container scanning, license compliance, and policy management to ensure more secure software releases.
badge_template.name: GitLab Certified Security Specialist

badge_template_activities.title: GitLab Certified Security Specialist is a technical certification offered by GitLab Professional Services to help the GitLab community and team members validate their ability to apply GitLab Security features and best practices in their daily work. To earn certification, candidates must first pass a 1-hour knowledge assessment, followed by a 1-hour hands-on lab assessment graded by GitLab Professional Services engineers.

badge_template.description: Un Cloud Digital Leader puede expresar con claridad las capacidades de los productos y servicios principales de Google Cloud y cómo se benefician las organizaciones. Un Cloud Digital Leader también puede describir casos de uso comerciales comunes y cómo las soluciones en la nube contribuyen a una empresa. Esta certificación está destinada a cualquier persona que desee demostrar sus conocimientos de los conceptos básicos de la computación en la nube los productos de Google Cloud.
badge_template.name: Cloud Digital Leader Certification (Español‬)
